output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S3 (rate tables and screen).
**Purpose:** verify the utilisation screen that fixes the v1 regime defect
(F3): a queue whose demand is far below supply cannot show a drought signal.
**Inputs:** `output/screen_report.csv`, `output/selected_gauges.csv`.
**Outputs:** none.
**Parameters:** `P$rho_window = c(0.15, 1.20)`.

## Utilisation definition

```
rho[g] = sum_t lambda(t) / sum_t mu(t)   over verified days
```

The predeclared admissible window is `0.15 <= rho <= 1.20`.

```{r}
scr <- nb_require("screen_report.csv", "S3")
sel <- nb_require("selected_gauges.csv", "S3")
nb_assert_cols(scr, c("gauge_id", "supply_variant", "mean_lambda",
                      "mean_mu", "rho", "in_window", "usable_days"),
               "screen report")
nb_assert(setequal(unique(scr$supply_variant), SUPPLY_VARIANTS),
          "not all three supply variants were screened")
n_bad <- sum(!is.finite(scr$rho))
cat(sprintf("non-finite rho rows (dry or unusable gauges): %d of %d\n",
            n_bad, nrow(scr)))

knitr::kable(
  scr[, .(gauges = .N, in_window = sum(in_window),
          median_rho = round(median(rho, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
          rho_min = round(min(rho, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
          rho_max = round(max(rho, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
      by = supply_variant],
  caption = "Utilisation screen by supply variant")
```

## Gate G3

```{r}
in_win <- scr[supply_variant == "SUP-1" & in_window == TRUE, uniqueN(gauge_id)]
cat(sprintf("SUP-1 gauges in window: %d (gate requires >= 15)\n", in_win))
nb_assert(in_win >= 15, "Gate G3 fails: fewer than 15 gauges in the window")
cat(sprintf("selected analysis set: %d gauges across %d basins\n",
            nrow(sel), data.table::uniqueN(sel$basin)))
```

`[measurement]` Under the primary SUP-1 variant the majority of profiled
gauges sit inside the window. This is the central design change from v1,
where utilisation was ~0.02-0.08 and a null was guaranteed before any data
were analysed.

```{r fig-rho}
s1 <- scr[supply_variant == "SUP-1"]
s1 <- s1[is.finite(rho)]
s1[, status := factor(ifelse(in_window, "inside window", "outside window"),
                      levels = c("inside window", "outside window"))]
ggplot(s1, aes(reorder(factor(gauge_id), rho), rho, colour = status)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = P$rho_window[1],
           ymax = P$rho_window[2], fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = P$rho_window, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#999999") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "candidate gauge (ordered by rho)", y = expression(rho),
       title = "Utilisation screen (SUP-1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```
